scope: First native-kT mixture-density DNN pilot, not a general flavor-resolved extraction
normalization: integral 2*pi*k*dk S=1; shared proton boundary for all active nf5 quark channels
model_restrictions: Positive fixed-width Gaussian mixture; broader than one Gaussian, narrower than an arbitrary kT function. No b-space prior equivalence claim.
fixed_g_origin: Declared conditional baseline from thesis-check Gaussian diagnostic; not a universally determined CS kernel
measurement: Conditional tabulated-mean E866 estimator with full Q,xF,qT weights; source energies preserved
training_representation: Native kT analytic Gaussian pair convolution and finite-volume elliptic operator; transforms only in independent validation
retained_physics: Prior massless nf5 W-only profile, PDF, coupling and strict insertions
closure_scope: Recover observable and sensitivity-supported projections; do not claim unique full TMD recovery
experimental_scope: First central fits and initialization checks. No calibrated uncertainty claim or global-fit claim.

smoothness_prior.quantity: mean sum of squared second differences of mixture weights with respect to log(x), divided by h^4
smoothness_prior.reason: Initial unrestricted networks exploited unresolved x variation; treat this as a declared model-prior change, not a numerical tolerance relaxation

experimental_checkpoint_continuation.scope: Continue all five exact saved parameters; unchanged objective and convergence tolerances; retain original iteration-limited results

closure_holdout: All 10 bins in Q=7.2-8.7 GeV; seed selection by training objective only
